response.sql: WITH customer_stats AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) as order_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders) as share FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT customer_id, order_count, share FROM customer_stats WHERE share >= (SELECT MIN(share) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT share FROM customer_stats WHERE share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10) AS top_shares) OR share IS NULL ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST
